description: This file defines the InvokeDispatcher class responsible for handling various commands related to UI canvas, camera, location, device info, notifications, system operations, photos, contacts, calendar, motion, SMS, call logs, and debugging within an Android application. It includes command routing, permission checks, and handlers for each command type.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for dispatching and handling various commands received from external sources, managing permissions, availability, and interactions with UI, hardware, and system components.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main entry point for handling an invoke command with parameters, routing to specialized handlers or returning errors if command is unknown.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Ensures A2UI is ready before executing associated command logic, handling host resolution and reachability checks.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Executes a block of code with canvas availability, catches exceptions related to canvas unavailability.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks command-specific availability requirements, returning an error result if requirements are not met.
